cast.name: Fire salamander
cast.note: Battered by Mr Magic's cold wave, dimmed and sagging, wary and weakening.

choices: Press the attack with more water
Call out and try to calm it
Smash the cooled scales with your staff

image.prompt: Very muscular man in his thirties, short dark hair, strong jaw, dark green travelling scarf over plain linen shirt, leather boots, sweeping a wooden staff as a huge cold wave of water crashes onto a huge ember-scaled salamander with yellow eyes, billowing steam, black rock bowl, glowing red spring, dusk
image.fallback: A bowl of black rock with a glowing red steaming spring, clouds of white steam and patches of ice at dusk.

answer.narration: You drag the staff through the air and a second wave surges out, colder than the first, crashing over the salamander as it struggles free of the ice. Steam bursts in a white wall. The beast screams, its glow sinking to a dull orange, and it staggers back toward the spring, thick tail dragging. Its yellow eyes stay fixed on you, wary now, not furious.
answer.summary: Mr Magic, a muscular fast-learning mage, tracked claw prints to the red spring, blocked by a giant ember-scaled salamander. He hit it with water, froze its path, then struck with a second cold wave. It is weakened and wary, retreating to the spring. Plan: defeat or calm the creature, free the spring, restore Karrowmere's water, conclude by turn 50.
